title: Laser Zap
blurb: A retro sci-fi laser zap with a descending pitch-bend — the sound every space shooter used before games had budgets. Great for edits that need a pew, transition sounds, or dramatically pointing at someone while making eye contact. Synthesized from scratch in the classic arcade style, so it's clean, original audio that's free to use in any project.
origin: Original synthesis in the style of golden-age arcade shooters.
